Emergency surgical drainage yielded 50 mL pus. Intraoperative findings revealed diffuse pharyngeal inflammation and a distinct fluctuating mass on the left posterior pharyngeal wall. Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolated from pus cultures guided the targeted antibiotic therapy.
